name: anchore/grype
description: Vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems supporting Docker, OCI, and Singularity formats. Integrates with Syft for SBOM generation and provides CVSS, EPSS, and KEV-based risk scoring.
score_rationale: 11.8k stars with active maintenance into March 2026, widely adopted in CI/CD pipelines as a fast and focused container vulnerability scanner.
